info.name: OpenConnector API Contract Suite
info.description:
Newman/Postman API-contract tests for the OpenConnector Nextcloud app. Locks the HTTP contract of openconnector's integration surface: Sources, Mappings, Rules, Endpoints, Jobs, Synchronizations, Webhooks (event_subscription), CloudEvents (event) and Consumers.

ARCHITECTURE: After the chain-C OR-cutover, per-schema CRUD no longer lives in openconnector controllers — it is delegated to OpenRegister's object API at /api/objects/openconnector/{schema}/* (ADR-022). openconnector's own controllers now only expose the integration ACTIONS: sources#test, jobs#run/test, synchronizations#run/test/contracts/statistics/logs, mappings#test, and the events (webhook subscription) lifecycle. This suite covers both: OR-delegated CRUD for every schema, and the openconnector action endpoints.

AUTH MODEL: collection auth is noauth; every authenticated request carries an EXPLICIT basic-auth block (admin:admin via adminUser/adminPass). Authorization (no-auth) requests use {{noAuthBase}} (127.0.0.1) so the host-scoped NC session cookie established by authed {{baseUrl}} (localhost) requests is never sent to them — keeping them genuinely unauthenticated. --ignore-redirects + Accept: application/json make NC return JSON 401 instead of a 303->login 200 HTML page.

PHASE-0 FIX LOCKED: POST /api/synchronizations/{id}/run no longer 500s on the run-log/hydrate path (commit b855af5b 'restore run-log write path to OpenRegister + nullable-safe hydrate'). The run happy-path test asserts a graceful 2xx/4xx (NOT 500) on a synchronization missing a source — i.e. the controller reaches the synchronize() service, writes a run-log and returns a clean validation error rather than crashing.

QUARANTINED REAL BUGS (asserted as the CURRENT 500, NOT faked passes — flip to happy-path when fixed):
 - synchronizations#test: catches Exception with statusCode:($e->getCode() ?? 400); getCode() returns 0 (not null) -> JSONResponse(status 0) -> NC Http.php#106 'Undefined array key 0' -> 500.
 - mappings#test: builds an OCA\OpenRegister\Db\ObjectEntity and passes it to MappingService::executeMapping() which requires OCA\OpenConnector\Db\Mapping -> TypeError -> 500 (always, regardless of body). Also throws InvalidArgumentException (uncaught -> 500) on missing params instead of returning 400.
 - jobs#run / jobs#test: JobService::executeJob writes a job_log with executionTime as a float where the job_log schema requires 'integer or null' -> OR validation failure -> 500.

findObjects/findObject NOTE: the OR-method findObjects()/findObject() non-existent-method calls were ALREADY migrated off development (commit 139423f6 'migrate Source/Mapping/Rule/Contract(Log) mappers onto OpenRegister'). No controller-reachable endpoint in 0.2.15 500s on a findObject OR-method call. The only remaining findObject* symbols are openconnector's local MongoDB ObjectService shim and SourceMapper::findObject (a real method on that class).

Usage: see run-newman.sh.

item.name: jobs#run real job (happy path: 200 success log)

exec: // FIXED: JobService::executeJob now writes a job_log whose 'executionTime' is
// cast to int and whose 'stackTrace' is normalised to an object, both matching
// the job_log schema, so the run passes OpenRegister validation and returns 200.
pm.test('jobs run: success-level log written', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('level'); pm.expect(b.level).to.not.equal('ERROR'); });
pm.test('jobs run: executionTime is an integer', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.executionTime === null || Number.isInteger(b.executionTime)).to.be.true; });

pm.test('jobs run: stackTrace is an object (not an array)', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.stackTrace === null || (typeof b.stackTrace === 'object' && Array.isArray(b.stackTrace) === false)).to.be.true; });

item.name: synchronizations#run on source-less sync (PHASE-0: graceful 4xx, NOT 500)

exec: // PHASE-0 FIX ASSERTION: the run path reaches synchronize(), writes a run-log and
// returns a clean validation error ('sourceId ... cannot be empty') with status 400.
// Before the b855af5b run-log/hydrate fix this path 500'd. The load-bearing
// assertion is NOT-500; the sync legitimately has no source so 400 is correct.
pm.test('run does NOT 500 (Phase-0 run-log/hydrate fix holds)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.not.eql(500));
